welcome.title: Welcome to Zorgwinkel
welcome.subtitle: Arrange your care from home, like doing your shopping.
welcome.featureAppointment: Book an appointment with your GP
welcome.featureCheck: Check everything before you send it
welcome.disclaimer: Zorgwinkel does not give medical advice. For that, you talk to your GP.

language.title: Choose your language
language.reloadText: The app restarts now to change the reading direction.

display.title: Make the app easy to read
display.subtitle: Choose what is easiest for you. You can change this later.
display.preview: This is how your text will look.

ready.title: You're ready.
ready.text: You can change these settings at any time under Language and display.

help.title: Ask a real person
help.subtitle: Talk to someone at your GP practice.

callback.title: Done. The practice will call you back.
callback.text: Usually within 2 hours on working days. Keep your phone nearby.

appointment.whoTitle: Who do you want to see?
appointment.noteLabel: Add a few words, if you want
appointment.whenTitle: When would you like to come?

added.title: Added to your basket
added.notSentYet: It will be sent when you check your basket.

basket.title: Your basket
basket.subtitle: Check your request before you send it.

confirm.title: Confirm it is you
confirm.text: Log in once with DigiD, the same login you use for your taxes or pension. Then your GP practice knows the request is from you.
confirm.privacy: Only you and your GP practice can see your medicines and appointments.
confirm.rememberMe: Remember me on this phone. You will not need to log in again.

digid.title: DigiD
digid.simulation: Test version: any 5 digits work. Your PIN is not saved or sent.
digid.error: Logging in did not work. Check your internet connection and try again.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome, {{name}}.
welcomeBack.text: Your details come from DigiD and your GP practice.

send.error: Sending did not work. Nothing has been sent and your basket is still here. Check your internet connection and try again.

receipt.title: Done. Your request has been sent.
receipt.text: The practice will send you a message within 1 working day.
